text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as our time with <chrname>
came to a natural turning point.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It seems everyone is present, desu wa.
Shall we head inside, then?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Where should we look around first!?
I heard that a famous waffle shop's
food truck is here today!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Waffles...!?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...N-No, we came here for an observation visit,
so such shops must wait until later. Yes, for later.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The ones in the paddock right now are
the members running in the upcoming debut race, right?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, just as you'd expect for their first race,
every last one of 'em's got a super tense face on!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: However... their gazes are sharp, filled with strength.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Each and every one of their races
begins right from this place.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (WOOOOAAAHHH!)

text_block_list.name: Winning Ticket
text_block_list.text:
WOOOOOAH! Surging up from the final 200m!
What an emotional final burst of speed, aaaahhh!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
The runner who finished second held on with such grit too...
It was truly a wonderful race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No matter the stage, and no matter the contenders,
races always stir such fiery passion in one's heart, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And that is precisely because everyone is running
toward their dreams with all their heart.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Because they're giving everything for their dreams...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
However, in order for us to earnestly strive toward our dreams,
support is indispensable.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Rivals, friends, teammates, trainers.
It is because of the support of those around us that we
can run at full power toward our dreams, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl A
text_block_list.text: I... I want to run in a race like that too!

text_block_list.name: Young Horse Girl B
text_block_list.text: Yeah, yeah! Let's aim for Tracen Academy together!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
...And the sight of running toward a dream
connects into brand new dreams, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Let us also run through every single step with all our might,
so that we may show someone a dream of their own.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, yes!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Now, we have some time before the next race,
so let us go check on the status of those waffles we put off... desu wa!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
These three years of running together with <chrname>—
perhaps they, too, have become someone's dream—
